'''Niccolo''' is an NPC who appears in [[Montelli Quarter]], [[Ragunna]]. He can be seen standing near a plant and waving to [[Novelli|Professor Novelli]] from 6:00 AM to 5:59 PM.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Novelli:''' Let me take a good look at you, the sword-wielding hatless one, and the promising Niccolo. Hmm, you've grown out of that naive boy and into a reliable adult.
:'''Niccolo:''' Ahem, I was young and full of myself back then, coming up with all kinds of silly names... Please don't make fun of me for it, Professor Novelli.
:'''Niccolo:''' Those who look out to sea often dream of setting sail, but after seeing it all, they long to ride the waves back home, where life truly takes root.
:'''Niccolo:''' Please accept this, Professor Novelli. I bought it just for you.
:'''Novelli:''' What a beautiful bundle of Sword Acorus... I didn't think you'd remember.
:'''Niccolo:''' Of course, you once told me it was your favorite flower.
:'''Niccolo:''' You used these flowers with their strong, straight stems to teach me how to fight opponents with a sword, long before I put my hands on a real one.
:'''Novelli:''' Yes. Traditionally, we used them in swordsmanship lessons for young nobles. But there was one child whom I recall was the exception.
:'''Niccolo:''' You mean that Montelli girl who bested me? I heard she has become an important figure in her family now.
:'''Niccolo:''' Losing to someone so much younger really got to me. Then I noticed the calluses on her hands... Unlike other nobles her age, she'd been training with a heavy, sharp metal sword from the start.
:'''Novelli:''' To her, fighting wasn't some noble virtue—it was a matter of life and death.
:'''Novelli:''' Perhaps that's the price of becoming a true Montelli.
:'''Niccolo:''' A hefty price, indeed... Now, those calluses mark my own hands, and I finally understand the look she gave me when she saw me with that Sword Acorus.
{{Dialogue End}}
